== Summary ==
Before/after image for [[Darth Plagueis]]: the PC card image of [[Darth Plagueis]] (26 December 2024, [[:File:V24-D-darthplagueis.gif|V24-D-darthplagueis.gif]], scaled to the slip height) beside the slip of the [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-24.pdf Virtual Set 24 release sheet] (page 1). Made from the two published images (Bill, 12 November 2026).
